messages:
sam: FYI partner Y pushed marketplace image tag v2.1.0 that includes ROCm 5.7 and a new int8 kernel. Our smoke harness shows a memory growth in continuous-batch workloads and a quantization mismatch for int8 configs.

lina: Do we have customer reports or just CI/evaller?

oscar: Only evaller and a couple of private beta customers reported higher OOMs when using batch_size>8 with streaming enabled. CI trace attached: logs/ci/1990012345/oom-trace.txt.

sam: Important: partner also changed SBOM layout. marketplace signing rejected earlier because of unexpected provenance path. marketplace-bot logged a scan warning.

marketplace-bot: scan-warning: SBOM path mismatch for image partner-y:v2.1.0, signature missing field "provenance.origin". See TKT-7623.

pat: Suggested immediate mitigations:
- Mark v2.1.0 as "do-not-recommend" in catalogue and pin default to v2.0.9.
- Add runtime-env shim to Dedicated images to force ROCm 5.6 until partner hotfix.
- Run targeted canary with streaming and batch combos before any broader rollout.

jas: Agreed. Also ask partner for exact kernel diff and int8 op list. We need a deterministic reproducer so SI partners can validate. Proposed repro snippet for them:

```
# repro (approx)
export ROCM_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
run_infer --model llama-7b-int8 --batch 16 --stream --context 4096 --duration 120s --log-level debug > repro.log
# watch for memory growth and int8 post-quant mismatch
```

sam: I'll contact partner-y product/eng. partner-y-bot: please open an engineering ticket and include stack traces + failed kernels.

partner-y-bot: engineering-ticket created: PY-9482. Partner notified and eng assigned. ETA initial triage 6h.

lina: For internal ops: avoid autoswitch in Dedicated from pinned v2.0.9. Add advisory to SI integrators: do not enable int8 quantization toggles by default until partner confirms.

oscar: I'll prepare a short compatibility note for SI/VARs with suggested temp flags and how to force host-side dequant. ETA 2h.

pat: Can we add an evaller check that runs an int8 classification + continuous-batch for 2 mins and fails if rss grows > 10%? Add to nightly and prerelease gates.

jas: Yes, I'll add a lightweight harness and baseline numbers for the next evaller run.

ops-bot: Ticket created: TKT-7623 (catalogue pin + marketplace advisory). Assigned to oscar, jas.

sam: Action list summary:
- @oscar: publish "do-not-recommend" marker for partner-y:v2.1.0 and pin default to v2.0.9 in marketplace (ETA 1h).
- @lina: block autoswitch in Dedicated builder and add environment shim for ROCm 5.6 (ETA 4h).
- @sam: partner sync + acquire kernel diffs and full SBOM (ETA 6h).
- @jas: add evaller int8 memory regression test and baseline (ETA next nightly).

lina: Also, require partner-signed checksum and updated SBOM before we lift the advisory. No image publishes until verification passes.

partner-y-bot: partner acknowledged: "We will supply kernel diff + corrected SBOM within 6h and a hotfix image by EOD".

sam: Good. Keep channel updated with the hotfix checksum and signature. If partner slips past EOD we escalate to partner manager for rollback or marketplace remove.

oscar: I'll notify top SI partners and list the temporary workaround commands.

marketplace-bot: Note appended to catalogue entry partner-y:v2.1.0: "Temporarily not recommended due to memory/quantization issues. Use v2.0.9 for production."

sam: Thanks all, post any regression traces here. We'll reopen the thread if partner provides build or we see customer impact.
